objective: Introduce a proposal-only CLM context-policy seam through ContextFabric with deterministic validation and no mutation or promotion authority.

rulesConsidered: ContextFabric is the sole production working-context facade.
A model may propose ContextEdit values; deterministic validation and ContextFabric own mutation.
CLM remains shadow-only and cannot gain execution, economics, artifacts, verification, release, memory-promotion, or model-promotion authority.
No new database or sovereign authority is introduced.
Every non-trivial change follows the Team Change Gate.

changes: Added typed CLMContextProposal and CLMContextProposalPort contracts.
Added deterministic CLM proposal fingerprinting and fail-closed validation.
Added ContextFabric.proposeCLMShadowEdits as a non-mutating shadow entry point.
Added negative/abuse tests for stale edits, non-CLM actors, duplicates, budget drift, tampered fingerprints, forbidden authority markers, and disabled mode.
Added a blocking machine-checkable CLM shadow boundary verifier.
Reconciled .okf architecture, decision evidence, and index entries.

verificationResults.note: BLOCKED is intentional until fresh exact-head evidence is recorded; no training, production CLM promotion, automatic proposal application, or ContextBench work is included.
